notes.title: Lui update
notes.content:
Fixed issue when Grass was spawning off the Grid.
HUD now shows the type of material and type to be spawned.
Additional quality setting for low-end PCs.
E button swaps between Voxel/Cluster Spawning.
Material/Type more visible on HUD.
Finetuned loading sequence.
Lowered overall game volume.
Map is larger with more room to terrain and voxel art sculpting.
Additional safeguards to prevent OffGrid spawning.
Holding Left Shift doubles move speed.
Middle Mouse Button changes target Voxel Material.
Grass only spawns from Loam and spreads on Sand and Loam.
Bubs eating Grass is added to save.
Lot of small stuff in the backend you won't notice anyway :)

notes.title: Jano update
notes.content:
Main menu has a rotating background showing your map progress.
Grass is now being saved to the map between sessions.
New main menu music for you to ignore.
Avaialble materials to use expanded to: Grass, Sand, Stone, Loam and Water.
Build/destroy range adjusted to make it more suitable for precision 3D sculpting.
Minor corredctions in HUD size and placement.
Added backup saves to overwrite the save game file manually, to reset the map.
Fixed bug when a chunky boi appears in the center of the map.
Holding the mouse button down spams build/destroy events after a second.
Fixed bug when you could build/destroy invalid positions if there was no valid target in crosshair.
Bubs burn less calories when moving so they need less food.
Some safeguards were added to ensure Grid consistency.
Map is extended, map boundaries are lowered so players can get closer to the bottom of the map.
Bubs leave bodies behind when they perish and then decompose over time.
Additional HUD elements for debugging.
All feedback is welcome as usual on the Hedra Discord: 
https://discord.gg/5mfw5JhwVM

notes.title: Nico update v.08.1.10
notes.content:
4 additional materials to Spawn and sculpt with.
Spam chains of Hedra blocks.
Updated Main Menu and HUD.
Grass is saved when it spreads and loaded with map.
Improved look angle.
Bubs could perish from malnutrition if they do not feed on grass.
